title: Coherent reduction and realization of twisted completed pullback
statement:
Fix a finite field $k_0$ of characteristic $p$, its algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ smooth separated of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. On the small pro-etale sites put $R_T=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(\mathcal O_E/\ell^n)_T$, $B_{n,T}=(\mathcal O_E/\ell^n)_T$, for $T=X,Y$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Write $\mathcal C_T=\Dbc(T,\mathcal O_E)$ for the derived-complete bounded constructible category [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], and $\mathcal N_T$ for the full subcategory of normalized constructible strict varying-coefficient towers with common cohomological and Tor bounds [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, sk-def-sp-normalized-towers]. Put $r_TA=(A\otimes^L_{R_T}B_{n,T})_n$ and $L_T=R\varprojlim\operatorname{Res}$, the total derived limit after restriction of scalars to $R_T$ [det-sp-normalized-equivalence].

Use the completed integral pullback $f^*_{\mathcal O_E}$ of [def-pur-integral-derived-operations] and the integral and finite Tate twists of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. For arbitrary integers $m,s$ and $K\in\mathcal C_Y$, put $P_{m,s}(K)=f^*_{\mathcal O_E}K(m)[s]$. Then $P_{m,s}(K)\in\mathcal C_X$, and the canonical pullback, tensor-with-the-Tate-line and shift coefficient comparisons form a natural isomorphism of entire derived towers
$$q_K:r_XP_{m,s}(K)\xrightarrow{\sim}\bigl(f^*_{B_n}(K\otimes^L_{R_Y}B_{n,Y})(m)[s]\bigr)_{n\geq1}.$$
It includes every quotient transition $B_n\to B_j$ for $1\leq j\leq n$, not just the displayed evaluations. Its component at $n$ is the composite of the canonical reduction comparison for completed pullback, the balanced derived tensor comparison using $\mathcal O_E(m)\otimes^L_{R_X}B_{n,X}\cong B_{n,X}(m)$, and the canonical shift comparison. These components commute with all coefficient quotient maps. For a uniformizer $\varpi_E$ and ramification index $e$, this is the restriction to the levels $en$ of the corresponding uniformizer-power construction, via $(\ell^n)=(\varpi_E^{en})$; the comparison uses the canonical quotient-ring identifications and is independent of a choice of generator for these ideals.

Consequently, for a functor $C:\mathcal C_Y\to\mathcal N_X$ and an isomorphism of derived towers $v_K:(f^*_{B_n}(K\otimes^L B_{n,Y})(m)[s])_n\xrightarrow{\sim}C(K)$ natural in $K$, the specified realization
$$P_{m,s}(K)\xrightarrow{u_{P_{m,s}(K)}}L_Xr_XP_{m,s}(K)\xrightarrow{L_X(q_K)}L_X\bigl(f^*_{B_n}(K\otimes^L B_{n,Y})(m)[s]\bigr)_n\xrightarrow{L_X(v_K)}L_XC(K)$$
is a natural isomorphism. This is a comparison of objects and morphisms in the derived category, rather than a degreewise cohomology assertion.

proof.text: The private proved categorical helper equivalenceRealization cancels the tower realization equivalence using its unit, yielding a natural isomorphism from completed reduction of the source to the underlying given C. Compose its total-limit image with the actual NX adjunction unit. Intrinsic derived completeness implies the legacy completeness predicate, using an auxiliary finite-field datum in universe zero; NX.unit_isIso applies. Thus every component is invertible, and naturality is the natural-transformation composition law. Expanding only the whiskering definitions verifies that this map is precisely realizationMap.
